title: 小狐狸第一次自己做生日蛋糕
logline: 小狐狸自己做蛋糕，學會努力並期待生日驚喜。

characters.name: 小狐狸
characters.appearance: orange fox, white belly, big eyes, little paws, red scarf, bushy tail, small ears
characters.personality: 好奇、用心、勇敢的小狐狸

panels.scene: 小狐狸決定自己做生日蛋糕。
panels.image_prompt: fox standing in cozy kitchen, looking excited, holding mixing bowl and spoon, warm sunlight through window

panels.scene: 小狐狸開始準備材料，手忙腳亂但很認真。
panels.image_prompt: fox mixing ingredients in bowl, some flour spilled on table, focused expression

dialogue.speaker: fox
dialogue.text: 先把麵粉和蛋攪拌均勻！

panels.scene: 小狐狸把蛋糕糊倒進模具裡，笑得很開心。
panels.image_prompt: fox pouring batter into cake mold, happy smile, kitchen background with utensils

dialogue.speaker: fox
dialogue.text: 倒進模具裡，蛋糕快完成了！

panels.scene: 蛋糕烤好，小狐狸拿出來，蛋糕膨脹金黃香噴噴。
panels.image_prompt: fox holding golden baked cake, proud expression, oven door open showing warmth

panels.scene: 小狐狸細心裝飾蛋糕，努力裝上草莓和奶油。
panels.image_prompt: fox decorating cake with strawberries and cream, concentrated face, colorful kitchen

panels.scene: 小狐狸抱著完成的蛋糕，滿足地看著。
panels.image_prompt: fox happily hugging birthday cake, warm light, cozy kitchen, feeling proud and joyful

dialogue.speaker: fox
dialogue.text: 這是我做的第一個蛋糕，好棒！
